itch.title: Skill notes: Spike Trap — choose the ground first
itch.bodyEN:
Today we are introducing an existing skill in EXODUSER: HELL LORD. Spike Trap is placed at your current position. It slows enemies within its area, applies bleed, and deals damage over time.

As enemies approach, you can choose the position where you will place the trap and the direction in which you will retreat. In what kind of encounter would you use it? We would also like to hear whether the placement description is clear.

This entry explains a development feature. It does not announce a new public-demo patch, and development content may differ from the public demo. No new gameplay recording is included here. A future normal-play demonstration should show placement at the player position, natural enemy movement through the area, and the result with original game audio.

The game uses AI-assisted art and audio.
Official skill note: https://www.youtube.com/post/UgkxhEsTSyRHSuYPkuEXJmUg-xnYL90AU9nj
Free Steam demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4749590
